clauses.quote: Readout-does-the-job is a halt: the control **matches or beats** the instrument (the instrument fails to beat the control by more than \(M_{\mathrm{match}}\)). Dynamics must change the meter.
clauses.subject: control

clauses.quote: Stop requires beating every named comparator by \(M_{\mathrm{beat}}}\). Ties are Halt, not Stop — Stop requires beating every named comparator by \(M_{\mathrm{beat}}}\).
clauses.subject: instrument

clauses.quote: Halt if the free conv beats the frozen bank by \(M_{\mathrm{beat}}}\).
clauses.subject: bank

clauses.quote: Halt (doctrine 5): a linear map with \(P_{\mathrm{max}}\) of the mix (if a mix exists) or \(P_{\mathrm{max}}^{\mathrm{ctrl}}\) (if no scar) **on raw patches** matches or beats the bank within \(M_{\mathrm{match}}}\).
clauses.subject: control

clauses.quote: If \(2\) matches \(3\) within \(M_{\mathrm{match}}}\), bank is not contributing — **halt**.
clauses.subject: configuration_2

clauses.quote: If \(4\) matches \(3\) within \(M_{\mathrm{match}}}\), the wave is decoration — **halt**.
clauses.subject: configuration_4

clauses.quote: Halt: wave+readout does not beat the control by \(M_{\mathrm{beat}}}\) on ARI.
clauses.subject: wave

clauses.quote: Halt: frozen-\(A\)+\(C\) does not beat the \(N\)-tap FIR by \(M_{\mathrm{beat}}}\) on the lag curve.
clauses.subject: stem

clauses.quote: Halt: frozen-\(A\)+\(C\) does not beat learned-\(A\) by \(M_{\mathrm{beat}}}\) on the lag curve.
clauses.subject: frozen_A
